report.answer: Application-level route handling is wired up in lib/application.js (and lib/express.js), where app.js lazily creates a base router via `this.router` getter and delegates app.use/app.route/app.param/app.handle to it. However, the router itself is NOT implemented inside expressjs/express in this version (5.2.1) — it's imported as an external dependency `var Router = require('router')` (npm package "router" ^2.2.0, listed in package.json), and lib/ only contains application.js, express.js, request.js, response.js, utils.js, view.js (no router/ subdirectory).
